'''Llek Huron''' was a [[Near-Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Titan Base]]'s back-up [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He lost one of his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] during an [[Torture/Legends|interrogation]].<ref name="OSG" />
